name: vid.pro/foul/soccernet_mvfoul
license: SoccerNet NDA for its data and annotations (SoccerNet/sn-mvfoul README); GPL-3.0 on the Hugging Face card
criteria_source: Adapted from the SoccerNet-MVFoul labels: action class, offence and the original five-level severity
notes: 268 incidents, each shown from 2-4 unsynchronized camera views. 200 action-class choices (8 options), 200 offence yes/no questions and 100 severity ratings on the original five levels. The answers come from SoccerNet's annotations, which SoccerNet shares under its NDA, so they ship as a recipe; `jevarena-mm build` fills them in from annotations.json of SoccerNet's release (fetched with the clips).

name: vid.pro/driving_risk/nexar
source: Nexar Collision Prediction, test set (Moura and Zvitia, 2025)
license: Nexar Open Data License (attribution; no resale)
criteria_source: Adapted from Nexar's labels: a test clip of an event ends 0.5, 1.0 or 1.5 s before the collision or near-miss
notes: 500 dashcam clips of about 10 s (median 9.97 s in both classes), one per original video: 250 end 0.5, 1.0 or 1.5 s before a collision or near-miss (133, 69 and 48 clips; many videos are cut at 0.5 s only), 250 are normal drives cut at the same points (136, 68 and 46), so neither clip timing nor length gives the answer.
